symptom: sqlparse 0.4.4 recurses once per nesting level when flattening a parsed statement, so a deeply nested bracket list (the advisory's proof of concept is 10,000 levels) raises RecursionError from sqlparse.sql.TokenList.flatten instead of returning a result. Fixed in 0.5.0, which flattens iteratively. Like the other deep-nesting entries, the minimal reproducer is still around a thousand levels deep, so this entry measures how quickly shrink ray strips nesting rather than how small it can go.
